purpose: Define a response-blind Palearctic Lepidoptera subgroup of the already completed 211-species phylogatR survivor universe for a new comparative-phylogeographic feasibility study.

historical_status.claim: response-blind subgroup redesign, not a newly collected prospective confirmatory response

source_universe.taxonomy_source: phylogatR genes.txt metadata from the exact source archive
source_universe.locality_source: selected COI-family Phase-1 occurrence coordinates reconstructed with the frozen selection rule

realm_dataset.title: Simplified Biogeographical Realms of the World (polygons)

eligibility.palearctic_fraction_definition: fraction of frozen selected-panel unique localities intersecting the official Palearctic polygon
eligibility.minimum_species_rationale: guarantee at least 10 species per half under the new deterministic 50/50 subgroup split before synthetic qualification

split.reason: the global 103/108 split was not designed for the subgroup and provisional screening showed strong subgroup imbalance
split.new_rule: sort eligible species by SHA256('<eligibility_contract_sha256>|split|<species>'); lower floor(n/2) are training, remainder evaluation

provisional_screen.note: A coarse coordinate proxy suggested roughly 29 Palearctic-dominant Lepidoptera; it cannot determine formal eligibility.

failure.interpretation: design infeasibility, not a biological null
